subject: Edgewise Health — request for extended eval + one-time credit uplift
messages:
From: Samantha Park <samantha@edgewise.io>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Request: extra eval runway + sample data window

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week — the model behavior looked very promising for our clinical summarization flow. Procurement and our security team are moving slower than expected due to an upcoming audit; they need another 6–8 weeks to sign a PO.

We have a technical milestone next month where we need a larger token budget to validate throughput under longer patient notes (roughly +500k tokens of usage). Is there any chance Redwood can authorize a one-time credit uplift and extend our sandbox by 60 days so we can finish the evaluation before the audit blocks us?

I attached the updated SOW that outlines the pilot milestones. If helpful, we can commit to a short contract after procurement closes. Appreciate any flexibility — we really want to get this over the line.

Attachments: Edgewise_POC_SOW_v2.pdf (PDF), Edgewise_security_questionnaire.xlsx (XLSX)

Best,
Samantha Park
Head of Partnerships
Edgewise Health
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Request: extra eval runway + sample data window

Karthik / Laura — forwarding Edgewise's ask. TL;DR: strategic mid-market prospect (healthcare), strong product fit for our structured summarization demo. They need a one-time +500k-token uplift and a 60-day sandbox extension because procurement delays (audit window). They can sign a PO once audit completes; updated SOW attached.

Why I think we should consider:
- Expected ARR hill: $180k in year one, expansion potential into clinical workflows.
- Technical unblock: additional tokens are necessary to validate latency and tokenization edge cases.
- Risk: if we fall back to standard PLG caps, they will pause evaluation and likely choose a competitor.

Ask: can Deal Desk approve a one-time credit equivalent to $6,000 and extend the eval by 60 days? If we need exec sign-off for anything beyond our policy, please escalate. If approved, I'll confirm with the customer and get the PO/SOW signed within 30 days of procurement clearance.

Attachments: Edgewise_POC_SOW_v2.pdf

Thanks — Irene
Irene Choi
Senior Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: FW: Edgewise Health — request for extended eval + one-time credit uplift (deal DW-4382)

Aditya — looping you in for discretionary approval. Irene is asking for a nonstandard uplift: +500k tokens (~$6k cost-equivalent) and a 60-day extension to the sandbox beyond PLG limits. Background: Edgewise is a healthcare prospect with strong strategic signals (expected $180k ACV Y1, potential for GxP work in future).

Options I considered:
1) Approve a full 60-day extension + full token uplift now (fastest path, higher short-term cost).
2) Approve a 45-day extension and 350k token uplift now, with the remaining tokens released after PO signature (compromise to limit exposure).
3) Deny uplift but offer prioritized onboarding and a credit-backed short-term increase if they provide a signed LOI/PO within 21 days (risk of losing momentum).

Recommendation: Option 2. That limits platform exposure but keeps the deal moving. If we approve anything >$5k equivalent, requires your sign-off per policy.

I've attached the SOW and the short usage forecast. Monica — please flag any billing/finance constraints.

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Deal Desk
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 16:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Edgewise Health — request for extended eval + one-time credit uplift (deal DW-4382)

Thanks for the clear options and rationale. I approve a limited, one-time exception under the following conditions:

1) Approve Option 2: 45-day sandbox extension + 350k-token one-time credit now.
2) Remaining 150k tokens to be provisioned only after we receive a signed PO or DocuSign SOW (must be countersigned within 30 days of audit close).
3) This is a one-time concession tied to DW-4382 and is non-recurring. Include usage monitoring and notify Deal Desk if consumption exceeds the uplift by >15%.
4) Finance (Monica) to record the uplift as a non-billable concession tied to the 2026 Q4 sales adjustments.

Irene — proceed and confirm with Samantha. Please get the signed SOW/PO per (2); if procurement won't commit, revert to the alternate: prioritized onboarding + trial throttles.

Aditya Rao
Chief Revenue Officer (acting)
Redwood Inference
